Why You’ll Love This mac’s pizza

  • Deliciously customizable with your favorite toppings.
  • Simple ingredients make it easy to whip up anytime.
  • Perfectly crispy crust that rivals your local pizzeria.
  • Fun to make with family and friends for a memorable night.

mac’s pizza

Discover the secrets to Mac’s Pizza! 🍕 Learn how to make authentic homemade pizza that will impress your family and friends.
Print Recipe Pin Recipe
Prep Time 15 minutes mins
Cook Time 12 minutes mins
dough resting 30 minutes mins
Total Time 57 minutes mins
Servings: 4 servings
Course: Main Course
Cuisine: Italian
Calories: 300
Ingredients Equipment Method Notes

Ingredients
  

Dough
  • 1 dough Pizza Dough for the base
  • 1/2 cup Tomato Sauce for spreading
  • 1 1/2 cups Shredded Mozzarella Cheese for that cheesy goodness
  • 1/4 cup Grated Parmesan Cheese for added flavor
  • 10 slices Pepperoni for topping
  • 1/2 teaspoon Dried Oregano for seasoning
  • 1/4 teaspoon Garlic Powder for a hint of garlic
  • 1 tablespoon Olive Oil for brushing
Garnish
  • to taste leaves Fresh Basil Leaves optional, for garnish

Equipment

  • 1 Baking sheet or pizza stone For baking the pizza
  • 1 Rolling Pin For rolling out the dough

Method
 

Preparation
  1. Preheat the oven to 475°F (245°C). This ensures a crispy crust!
  2. Roll out the pizza dough on a lightly floured surface to your desired thickness. Make it as thick or thin as you like!
  3. Carefully transfer the rolled-out dough to a baking sheet or pizza stone. It’s time to build your pizza!
  4. Brush the edges of the dough with olive oil. This will give your crust a beautiful golden color.
  5. Spread tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a small border around the edges. Don’t be shy with the sauce!
  6. Sprinkle garlic powder and dried oregano over the sauce. This adds a lovely flavor kick!
  7. Generously top with shredded mozzarella and grated Parmesan. Cheese makes everything better!
  8. Arrange pepperoni slices evenly on top of the cheese. Feel free to add as many as you like!
  9. Bake for 10–12 minutes or until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly. Your kitchen will smell amazing!
  10. Remove from the oven, garnish with fresh basil if desired, slice, and serve hot. Enjoy your homemade mac’s pizza!

How to Make mac’s pizza

Get ready to create a delicious mac’s pizza! This recipe takes about 15 minutes to prepare and 10–12 minutes to cook. Allow for an extra 30 minutes if you’re letting the dough rest. Let’s dive in!

Step 1: Preheat the oven

Preheat the oven to 475°F (245°C). This ensures a crispy crust!

Step 2: Roll out the dough

Roll out the pizza dough on a lightly floured surface to your desired thickness. Make it as thick or thin as you like!

Step 3: Transfer the dough

Carefully transfer the rolled-out dough to a baking sheet or pizza stone. It’s time to build your pizza!

Step 4: Brush the edges

Brush the edges of the dough with olive oil. This will give your crust a beautiful golden color.

Step 5: Spread the sauce

Spread tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a small border around the edges. Don’t be shy with the sauce!

Step 6: Add seasonings

Sprinkle garlic powder and dried oregano over the sauce. This adds a lovely flavor kick!

Step 7: Top with cheese

Generously top with shredded mozzarella and grated Parmesan. Cheese makes everything better!

Step 8: Add pepperoni

Arrange pepperoni slices evenly on top of the cheese. Feel free to add as many as you like!

Step 9: Bake the pizza

Bake for 10–12 minutes or until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly. Your kitchen will smell amazing!

Step 10: Serve and enjoy

Remove from the oven, garnish with fresh basil if desired, slice, and serve hot. Enjoy your homemade mac’s pizza!

Recipe Snapshot

Pro Tips for Making mac’s pizza

  • Preheat your oven to the highest setting for a crispy crust.
  • Use a pizza stone for even heat distribution.
  • Let your dough rest for at least 30 minutes for better texture.
  • Experiment with fresh herbs for a burst of flavor.
  • Don’t overload on toppings; less is often more!

How to Serve this mac’s pizza

  • Slice it up and serve with a side of garlic dipping sauce.
  • Pair with a fresh garden salad drizzled with balsamic vinaigrette.
  • Top with fresh basil or arugula for a burst of flavor.
  • Enjoy with a refreshing sparkling water or homemade lemonade.

Make Ahead and Storage

Storing and enjoying your Mac’s Pizza leftovers is easy!

Storing mac’s pizza Leftovers

  • Allow pizza to cool to room temperature.
  • Wrap slices tightly in plastic wrap or aluminum foil.
  • Place wrapped slices in an airtight container.
  • Store in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.

Freezing mac’s pizza

  • Cool pizza completely before freezing.
  • Wrap each slice in plastic wrap, then foil.
  • Place wrapped slices in a freezer-safe bag or container.
  • Freeze for up to 2 months for best quality.

Reheating mac’s pizza

  • For best results, reheat in the oven at 375°F (190°C).
  • Place pizza on a baking sheet for even heating.
  • Heat for about 10-15 minutes or until hot.
  • Alternatively, use a skillet on medium heat for a crispy crust.
